name: CodeRabbit
tagline: CodeRabbit is an AI code review tool that automatically analyses every pull request and posts line-by-line feedback on bugs, security issues, performance problems, and style violations. It integrates with GitHub and GitLab, summarises what a PR changes in plain English, and learns from developer feedback over time. Engineering teams use it to catch issues before human reviewers see the PR, reducing back-and-forth and speeding up the review cycle significantly.
